RAID BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Venena the Lil Empress!!
Now's the time to end this.\nAre you prepared...?
...Come on!
What?!
W-What is this?!\nGwa! Gb... Agggbb...
Sirrrrr!!
W-W-What happened?!\nWhat the heck is that thing?!
No!!
Felien!!
I... It's!!
Ah ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!!
Ha ha ha! How did you like it? This is the new\npower source. Durable, powerful, and it can charge\nenergy by eating living things automatically.
This is totally perfect.
Well, sometimes it eats the user like this.
But it produces more power in that case, so\nit's fine!
What have you done... I've seen your cruel\nactivities many times but you even killed\nmy boss and colleagues... You are a monster!!
Dad! No, not any more!\nDr. Brahe!! Be prepared!
Huh? Ha ha ha ha ha!\nYou just said I'm a monster?\nThat's too funny!
Oh, my pretty Felien!\nHaven't you ever think about this?\nNot even one time?
You fell off from a cliff that is as high as\n10-story building but you were not hurt.\nBut why?
You arm was caught in a huge machine and crushed.\nBut on the next day, your arm was back, but why?
You remember them all right?\nIs it really possible for a human?
W-What? What do you mean?\nYou treated me right?\nIf I was not a human, what am I?!
You wanna know it? Okay...
You are a sample of Demi Machinas that I tried to\ncreate just like human beings on a whim!
W-Whaaaaaaaaaat?!
I am a Demi Machina... No... Am I...
Yes! You are one of the ugly stuffs that you hate\nso much!! You must be grateful for growing up\nas my daughter!!
There's one more thing you might wanna know.\nYou fall in to the category of flop!!
Demi Machina... Flop...
You've been a parent and daughter for 10 or more\nyears, haven't you? How could you call your\ndaughter flop?! What kind of father are you?!
I am not her father!!\nHow many times do you think I had to fix the\ndefects for the 10 or more years?!
I had to fix tremendous number of times!\nImagine how I felt!!
N-No... I was born weak...\nI often used to get sick...\nBut that was defects...?
But I can throw away such a trash today!\nI've found an existence that surpasses\nthe abilities of humans and Demi Machinas!!
T-The empress?!\nWait, you mean...
Sir!!
Siiirrr!! ...You... Monster!!
Gwah!!
Balft... Agh!!
Haaaaahh!!
Ugh?!
Not the time for a failure...
Felien!!
!! Felien!
Is that you, Balft? I'm sorry...\nIt's dark... I can't see any thing...
It's just a scratch! Pull yourself together!
Heh... You're a bad liar.\nHey, what's the color of this thing flowing on\nmy body?
Dark blue liquid is flowing from the machine\nin her chest...
Red... It's red, of course!\nBrahe... He was lying... It's obviously red.\nYour blood is red! You're a human!!
You're really poor at lying... But...
Ha ha... Ha ha ha... Bwa ha ha ha ha!
Was it fun? A comedy with a useless doll?\nHa ha ha!!
But I'm so sad too! If you and Felien got married,\nI might be able to see a kid between a human and\nDemi Machina!! A ha ha ha ha!
You pervert scientist!!\nWhat's the color of your blood?!
I have no idea.\nAt least, better than Coenubia I guess.\nHya hya hya!
Coenubia? The one who made York betray Pax\nTechnista?! Tell us about her or him!!
Her or him? You think Coenubia is a human's name?!\nHa, ha ha ha ha!\nHow ignorant you are!!
Mmmm... Sorry, I'm ignorant!\nWhat kind of monster if it's not a human?!
Not a human, then a monster... Such an airhead.\nWell, fine. Coenubia is an amorphous living\nthing with high intelligence.
Have you seen the ominous colored crystals or\nslimy deformed things? No?
They are Coenubia!\nTheir body structure is totally different from\nours!
They were not in this world for the first time.\nThey came to this world after an incident happened.\nIt's...
I hate chatter...
What... have you done...
I just killed a chatty monkey.\nSo what?
By the way, what's that attitude?\nI am the Empress. Kneel down before me...
Shut up!! You ate the captain...\nHe was waiting for me to have it out with me...\nAnd Felien... You...
And you ate Dr. Brahe who disgraced Felien!
You took out all the guys I had to deal with...\nI won't forgive you!!
Balft!!
Come on! Adventurer!!
You look like you can't let it end like this.\nMe neither...
Find me and I'll settle down there...\nWell, if you don't value your lives.
T-The Empress flew away...\nBut where to...?
The direction might be...
No...
It's Eldenbaum for sure!!
Duhee?! No!
She could do anything there...\nWe've gotta report to the King in El Scaro!!
Hey, can we stop by Hora Diomedea?\nAdala must be waiting for us...
Should be okay to tell her that we are safe\nbefore going to El Scaro, right?
